card.name: Decimal point inside strengths and prices
card.fires_on: The decimal point (or the digit right after it) in a number such as 1.3% or 1.2% after a product name, and in a price like 59.95. Most often in the repeated name DICLOFENAC EPOLAMINE TOPICAL SYSTEM 1.3%.

modes.label: Strength after product name
modes.description: The period in a decimal percentage strength following a drug product name.
modes.example: Avoid the use of DICLOFENAC EPOLAMINE TOPICAL SYSTEM 1<<.>>3% in patients with severe heart failure

modes.label: Digit after the point
modes.description: The digit following the decimal point in the same strength.
